Multi-ball fields three balls at once, each its own contest: its own hold
timer, its own launch at a random angle, and its own respawn onto a field
that never stops for a point. The balls collide with one another, and a
ball waiting on its home point is solid. The replay is a stretch of a real
Solo match against the reference implementation's AI — three balls traded
at once, mid-air collisions, and points conceded on both sides while a
paddle is busy elsewhere — captured from the reference implementation in
live play.
